assertions.subject: Malignant Spindle Cell Sarcoma
assertions.quote: Tumors with spindle cell and fibrous morphology are also important group for differential diagnosis

assertions.subject: Primary mediastinal (thymic) large B cell lymphoma
assertions.predicate: diffuse infiltration of mediastinal soft tissue
assertions.quote: Primary mediastinal (thymic) large B cell lymphoma demonstrates diffuse infiltration of mediastinal soft tissue and surrounding structures with atypical B cells

assertions.subject: Primary mediastinal (thymic) large B cell lymphoma
assertions.quote: the CD20 and or CD79a markers should be positive

assertions.subject: Nodular sclerosis variant of Hodgkin disease
assertions.predicate: sclerotic lesions with nodules of eosinophils and histiocytes
assertions.quote: Nodular sclerosis variant of Hodgkin disease histologically represents sclerotic lesions with nodules of eosinophils and histiocytes admixed with lymphocytes and plasma cells

assertions.subject: Nodular sclerosis variant of Hodgkin disease
assertions.quote: Reed-Sternberg cells would express positivity for CD15+, CD30+, and MUM1, and weakly positive for PAX5

assertions.subject: Sclerosing mediastinitis
assertions.predicate: lack of large atypical B cells
assertions.quote: Sclerosing mediastinitis lacks the population of large atypical B cells

assertions.subject: Diffuse desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma
assertions.quote: Diffuse desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma is a hypercellular spindle cell tumor with dense paucicellular hyalinized collagen on a background and characteristic immunohistochemical staining for keratin

assertions.subject: Aggressive low-grade peripheral sheath tumor
assertions.quote: Aggressive low-grade peripheral sheath tumor and neurofibroma cells show spindle cell morphology and are positive for S100 and SOX10 and negative for MUC4

assertions.subject: Solitary fibrous tumor
assertions.predicate: spindle cells with homogeneous to ovoid nuclei
assertions.quote: In solitary fibrous tumor spindle cells have homogeneous to ovoid nuclei and an indistinct cytoplasm and are positive for CD34 and STAT6, and negative for cytokeratins, S100, EMA, muscle markers and melanoma-associated markers

assertions.subject: Pulmonary and mediastinal synovial sarcomas
assertions.quote: Pulmonary and mediastinal synovial sarcomas and low-grade fibromyxoid sarcomas are extremely rare, and only few cases were published in the literature

assertions.subject: Extra abdominal form of deep (aggressive) fibromatosis
assertions.predicate: spindle cell neoplasm with ill define borders
assertions.quote: Extra abdominal form of deep (aggressive) fibromatosis can involve thorax. Histologically, it is spindle cell neoplasm with ill define borders
